comment: OHSidian engine tuning flags (Chromium switches). touchSlopDistance: tap tolerance, larger = taps register more easily (try 8~48 if buttons are hard to press). forceDeviceScaleFactor: 0 = follow engine default, try 1.25/1.5 if the whole UI is too small on your tablet. extraFlags: raw Chromium switches appended verbatim. videoHwDecode (round 95b): route <video>/<audio> decode to the SYSTEM codec service instead of the bundled software ffmpeg - the engine already links libnative_media_vdec.so (HarmonyOS AVCodec; hardware HEVC/H.264 is included on Huawei devices) and its MediaCodecDecoderBridgeImpl declares video/avc + video/hevc. Several feature-name spellings are listed because the engine's gate name could not be confirmed statically - unknown names are ignored harmlessly by Chromium. If video playback regresses, delete the extraFlags entry below (no code change needed). ThirdPartyStoragePartitioning disabled (round 96): un-partitions third-party site storage inside embedded web logins (Custom Frames etc.) so cookie-based logins survive restarts; the feature string exists in this engine build. NOTE: a user-editable override file is supported at <filesDir>/ohsidian-flags-user.json (extraFlags only, appended after these, no repack needed).
